title: Eh
body:
Cute but so many pop ups it's annoying. 
I've only just started and the constant asking for a review or to double my carrots really takes away from the charm of the game. I hope it gets better.

title: So many ads
body: Cute app but basically each time you finish a task and fill it in you have to watch an ad. Its so annoying and makes it feel less rewarding and less satisfying.
